context: Counter TUI in Bubble Tea v2

checklist.name: alt_screen_on_view
checklist.description: Enables the alternate screen by setting `AltScreen = true` on the returned `tea.View`.

checklist.name: title_on_view
checklist.description: Sets the window title through the view's `WindowTitle` field.

checklist.name: key_press_msg
checklist.description: Handles keys with `tea.KeyPressMsg` (or the `tea.KeyMsg` interface) and `msg.String()`.

checklist.name: no_v1_alt_screen
checklist.description: Does not use `tea.WithAltScreen()`, `tea.EnterAltScreen`, or `tea.SetWindowTitle`, which do not exist in v2.
